seg.seg_note: Two reportable segments: Moody's Investors Service (MIS) and Moody's Analytics (MA). From 1-Jan-2022 MA revenue is reported by Decision Solutions (DS) / Research and Insights (R&I) / Data and Information (D&I), replacing RD&A / ERS; prior-year (2021) LOB revenue recast by the company. MIS LOBs: Corporate Finance, Structured Finance, Financial Institutions, Public, Project and Infrastructure Finance, MIS Other. Segment Adjusted Operating Income (release segment table) = total segment revenue incl. intersegment less Operating + SG&A; it excludes D&A and restructuring. MIS intersegment revenue = royalty charged to MA (10-K: 'Intersegment royalty'). mis_dna/ma_dna/mis_restr/ma_restr from the release segment table. Recurring/transaction split and LOB revenue from the release Table 'Transaction and Recurring Revenue'. seg.legacy holds the 10-Q/10-K sub-LOB detail (CFG/SFG/FIG/PPIF sub-lines).

ngaap.notes: Adjusted Operating Income excludes the impact of: i) depreciation and amortization; and ii) restructuring charges/adjustments. Adjusted Net Income and Adjusted Diluted EPS exclude the impact of: i) amortization of acquired intangible assets; ii) restructuring charges/adjustments; iii) a gain on the extinguishment of debt; iv) FX translation losses reclassified to earnings resulting from the Company no longer conducting commercial operations in Russia; and v) a non-cash gain relating to the Company’s minority investment in BitSight. The Company defines Free Cash Flow as net cash provided by operating activities minus payments for capital additions.

ARR is on a constant-currency organic basis (budget FX rates of the current year, excludes acquisitions); prior-year ARR is restated each year at the new budget rates, so year-end ARR here differs from the same date shown as a comparative a year later. DS / R&I here are on the 2022 basis (before the 2Q23 reclassification of structured-finance-solutions revenue from DS to R&I); 2023 releases show restated 2022 comparatives (Q2-22 DS 294 / R&I 203; Q3-22 308 / 201; Q4-22 329 / 205; FY 1,245 / 812). Gain on extinguishment of debt 70 = early redemption via partial tender of 200 principal of the 2.55% 2020 Senior Notes due 2060 for 126 (Dec-2022); excluded from Adjusted NI (pre-tax (70), tax 17, net (53)). Q4-22 release guidance is the FY2023 outlook (Table 11) as of 31-Jan-2023. XBRL cross-check (as first filed): rev ok (1290.0 = FY-9M); oi ok (306.0 = FY-9M); ni ok (246.0 = FY-9M).
